first_prompt: The following is the Codex agent history added since your last approval assessment. Continue the same review conversation. Treat the transcript delta, tool call arguments, tool results, retry reason,

commits.summary: Retire blinded and Claude treatments from upgrade engineering
commits.body: Use one gpt-6.2-astra session at high effort for selection, preparation, review and checking, with identified revision pairs and preserved first outcomes. Mark each of the six existing Claude opening reports superseded and unscored at the user's 03:05 UTC change of direction. The original V0 engine and lock stay reproducible. Checked all six records and compiled the prospective lock generator.

commits.summary: Read JVM modified UTF-8 in original class-file intake (verification pending)
commits.body: Decode encoded NULs and supplementary Java identifiers, preserve isolated UTF-16 code units, and reject malformed encodings in the preparation and impact readers. The exact old and new Commons Text StringEscapeUtils classes both stopped V0 at byte C0. The repaired reader sees the real escapeCsv descriptor and all 20 declarations on each. All 25 affected test groups passed. Job 20261121-033202-replay-both-commons-text-csv-tasks-after exercises both full CSV replay routes and the quote-doubling control.

commits.body: Run the frozen V0 class reader and checker and the repaired class reader on the same original sources and ordered Maven graphs. 20261121-034247-original-upgrade-corpus-v0-and-class-int, 20261121-034303-corpus-02-compare-v0-and-repaired-class, 20261121-034303-corpus-03-compare-v0-and-repaired-class, 20261121-034303-corpus-04-compare-v0-and-repaired-class, 20261121-034303-corpus-05-compare-v0-and-repaired-class, 20261121-034303-corpus-06-compare-v0-and-repaired-class, 20261121-034304-corpus-07-compare-v0-and-repaired-class, 20261121-034304-corpus-08-compare-v0-and-repaired-class. Verified all 64 original source identities, 24 main and 8 transfer assignments, and exercised the two-sided native launch on real ReflectASM bytes with a stand-in. Eight previously collected original JVM trial records supply plain references for ReflectASM and EA Async.

commits.summary: Bind JVM replay receipts to the actual JDK version (verification pending)
commits.body: Read the JDK's version line even when the launcher prints JVM options first. Pass the configured temporary directory to isolated controls. After the modified UTF-8 fix both original Commons Text runs produced 156 expected fields and the mutant disagreed on 71, but the launcher banner made those receipts ineligible. Captured the failed run and its unchanged raw observations. All 26 affected test groups passed. Job 20261121-034615-349-qualify-fresh-csv-replays-with-confi repeats both routes on JDK 21.

commits.summary: Record all 32 V0 comparisons and qualify the original CSV control
commits.body: Eight queue jobs returned 64 original-pair reports. All 24 main and eight transfer cases stayed open on V0 and after the class-reader repair. Across the main set, six cases required an instance receiver, five required an exact overload, five stopped in Maven resolution, four at multi-release JARs, three at unsupported parameters and one at a missing runtime coordinate. Checked every V0/current pair, both strata and the independent transfer split. The qualified CSV job ran on the original client at both pins, with 156/156 expected outputs and 71 discrepancies on the mutant.

commits.summary: Exhaust boolean caller paths and compare ordered JVM array returns (verification pending)
commits.body: The finite checker now visits both boolean inputs in fresh JVMs, retaining primitive integer arrays element by element, null, and the exception outcome. A differing input is replayed again and bound to its original classpath and typed argument. This can check callers that require a real JDBC driver without introducing a database model. Added controls for ordered values, numeric width, invalid boolean witnesses and incomplete domains. All 45 affected test groups passed. Job 20261121-035106-348-exhaust-both-jdbc-insert-shapes-on-t runs the unchanged rxjava-jdbc claim against both original H2 releases.

commits.summary: Prepare exact local Git revisions through the normal Java target workflow
commits.body: Accept named local Git sources scoped to an explicitly supplied directory and optionally import two plain source trees without Git filters or changes to their bytes. The workflow verifies the exact commits, trees and recorded parent. Remote Git acquisition retains its host restriction. Both revisions of rxjava-jdbc and Commons Text reached artifacts-ready offline through the public source lock and preparation paths. Regression controls cover binary content, ancestry, repeated names and paths outside the store. All 45 affected test groups passed.

commits.summary: Check the unconditional preservation region on real JDBC callers (verification pending)
commits.body: Recognize the workflow's literal false allowed-change predicate as unconditional preservation. The first queued finite attempt recorded its refusal before Java. A capped run of the complete repaired route admitted both booleans and qualified the true witness in fresh JVMs on the original classpaths: the combined insert returned [2] versus [1, 2], and separate inserts agreed. The targeted finite-domain regression passed. Job 20261121-040719-348-qualify-original-jdbc-arrays-across archives the full public check.

commits.summary: Qualify the real JDBC counterexample and mark Commons Text prepared
commits.body: The queued finite JVM proof admitted and independently checked both boolean inputs on each original Rx and H2 classpath. The combined insert returned [2] versus [1,2] on the two releases and the separate-insert companion agreed. The new and original classes and witness are recorded in the example. Commons Text now passes the standard example validation and both fresh replay tasks, with a correct router entry for the canonical queue receipts.

commits.summary: Load the actual multi-release JAR entries for a pinned native JVM (verification pending)
commits.body: Native target workflows bind JAR selection to a verified Java release. Read the highest eligible class or resource, preserve classpath precedence, include the selection in the proof cache and check actual caller bytes during preparation. Unbound or overridden runtimes retain the conservative refusal. The original JVM countermodel now proves the versioned result 20 and rejects the base result 1. Tested folded manifests, lower and higher feature releases, and entry sections. The changed run exercised 58 Rust targets and 42 Python groups. After correcting inventory and keeping the selected revision local to the binding check, reran the lint and both workflow regressions successfully. Queue jobs 20261121-042108-multi-release-corpus-group-1-check-eight, 20261121-042108-multi-release-corpus-group-2-check-eight, 20261121-042109-multi-release-corpus-group-3-check-eight, 20261121-042109-multi-release-corpus-group-4-check-eight, 20261121-042108-352-check-the-actual-duration-caller-thr repeat all 32 original upgrades and the Jackson calibration.

commits.summary: Find and replay the real caller on original dependency upgrade classpaths (verification pending)
commits.body: Discover concrete caller methods and exact overloads from original bytecode, then run a finite, source-reviewed observer on the original classpaths. The debugger sees a real entry into the declared method and descriptor for every input and repetition. JAR origins, exact UTF-16 results or escaping exceptions, independent expectations and stable repeated JVMs qualify each decision. The negative regression loads the client and references a call in an untaken branch, and correctly earns no result. A real ReflectASM probe reproduced the changed behavior with all eight original method-entry checks. Of 42 affected test groups, the history-span test failed while collection was active and passed when repeated; the updated three replay tests and tier lint pass. Jobs 20261121-042207-finite-caller-group-1-qualify-original-a, 20261121-042207-finite-caller-group-2-qualify-original-a, 20261121-042207-finite-caller-group-3-qualify-original-a, 20261121-042207-finite-caller-group-4-qualify-original-a, 20261121-043632-finite-caller-group-5-replay-original-ma, 20261121-043632-finite-caller-group-6-replay-original-ma, 20261121-043003-overload-recovery-group-1-compare-sixtee, 20261121-043003-overload-recovery-group-2-compare-sixtee cover 63 finite inputs across 16 upgrades and a full 32-case exact-overload rerun.
